stop_reason: GSE233485 contains no exercised animals: all 35 samples are sedentary WT/PGC-1a mKO/mTG mice at 3 or 24 mo. The paper's exercise effects are proteomic (wheel running, ref 21; treadmill 25 mo, MassIVE MSV000092099; FIG4C/D, S1.4.p1). An mTG-vs-WT or age contrast is a genetic or aging estimand and must not be reported as an exercise effect.
